# Quick Outline

![build](https://img.shields.io/badge/build-passing-green)

Quick Outline adds fast, configurable per-object outlines to Unreal Engine projects without post-process materials on every mesh.

## Features

- Per-object outline color, width and occlusion mode
- **X-ray** view for objects behind walls
- Blueprint-friendly `UQuickOutlineComponent`
- Works with [Enhanced Input](https://example.com) interaction highlights

## Installation

Copy into your project's Plugins folder.
